purpose: Teach: セキュリティー/書き込む/宝くじ/猛烈/若しくは/つかみ/近々/なんだかんだ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、セキュリティー強いな
lines.en: Your home security's pretty tight, isn't it?
lines.style: Teasing observation, eyes narrowed with curiosity. Light, almost playful edge. Leans in slightly, fishing for a story.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ブログに何でも書き込むよな、桜
lines.en: You're the one who posts everything on your blog, though.
lines.style: Dry half-smile. Quick parry — not mean, just efficient. Turns her own observation back at her. Settling into the rhythm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、宝くじ買うとか言ってたな
lines.en: Didn't you say you were thinking about buying a lottery ticket?
lines.style: Caught you. Playful gotcha. Leans back with a small satisfied smile, testing whether he remembers what he'd mentioned.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストで猛烈に頑張ってたな、桜
lines.en: You really pushed hard on that test though, didn't you?
lines.style: Sincere underneath the cool. Quiet acknowledgment — genuine observation, not flattery. Meets her eye steadily, meaning it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、英語若しくは数学、どっちが好き?
lines.en: Which do you like better — English or math?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity. Opens the question without performance. Waiting for the real answer beneath whatever she says first.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、観客の心をつかみたい役者目指してるな、桜
lines.en: You're aiming to be an actor who can really capture an audience's heart, aren't you?
lines.style: Slow, reflective. Careful precision — he's seen something true in her. Not quite a question, more like thinking out loud about what he's noticed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、近々、文化祭の予定だな
lines.en: So the school festival's coming up soon.
lines.style: Statement more than question. Gentle observation. Wondering if that's where she's headed with her ambitions.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: なんだかんだで今日もダラダラ過ごしたな、桜
lines.en: Anyway, we pretty much just wasted the whole day again, didn't we?
lines.style: Self-aware, slightly rueful. Soft laugh built in. Acknowledging time passed with her without regret, just wry acceptance.
